label: Pre-encounter — a fault on the floor
location: The Molten Forge, the main floor

recentEvents.value: The floor bells have rung; apprentices are walking stock and ledgers down the cooling galleries.
An armed stranger has walked past three hundred plowshares looking for a war. There is none here.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A fault that understands every warning and will not correct.

temporaryObjective.value: Correct the fault: show the envoy what the forge makes, and see him off the floor.
